answer: Audits are recorded in jade, queued in nebula, and dune publishes the wait time. A farm of 178 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 77 identities per epoch. A farm of 3917 identities would post 3664 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
